content: changesets/action@v1 detects changesets on main, opens/updates Version Packages PR, publishes on merge via publish input (e.g. pnpm changeset publish). Works with pnpm. OIDC trusted publishing preferred over NPM_TOKEN; changeset publish works with npm OIDC. Known issue: E404 on scoped monorepo packages with OIDC (npm/cli#8976, unresolved as of check) — fallback granular token + --provenance. Snapshot releases via seek-oss/changesets-snapshot with workflow_dispatch.
